answer.summary: No prior evidence supports superior memory management through temporal or contextual mechanisms in stable input conditions without feature vectors.
answer.content: After exhaustive review of Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, no explicit, non-feature-based mechanisms for temporal smoothing, sequence coherence, behavioral drift, or memory persistence were identified. The focus must now shift to a distinct, narrowly defined aspect of memory behavior that remains unexplored in the literature but is critical to evaluating superiority in memory management under stable conditions.
answer.search: handoff to analyst to retrieve and inspect Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 for explicit descriptions of memory update frequency and any reported latency or delay in state transitions under stable, low-variation input conditions without predefined feature vectors

answer.lesson: Avoid speculative or broad memory research questions when prior evidence is absent; narrow focus to a single, distinct mechanism for empirical grounding and testability in research-only phase.
